title: Swarm
description: Manage registered runtimes and run model discovery across agents.
noAgentsDesc: Run the agent binary on a machine with Docker to add it to the swarm.
addAgentDesc: Agents run on machines where you want to serve models. Install the agent binary on the target machine and point it at this backend — it registers itself and appears here automatically.
addAgentDescShort: Agents run on machines where you want to serve models.
apiKeyNote: If the backend has an API key configured, set api_key in agent.yaml to match.
filterPlaceholder: Filter by container name or id…
startContainerHint: Start a container on the agent machine and it will show up here.

agent.noRuntimesDesc: Register a container or script to auto-discover its models.

concurrency.noRuntimes: No runtimes registered on this agent yet.
concurrency.legend: Toggle which runtimes may share resources on this agent. Each row/column is a registered runtime — turning a cell ON allows both to run at the same time. An empty row (all OFF) means the runtime runs alone.
concurrency.runsAlone: Runtimes with all cells off run independently and will not share resources.

runtime.maxConcurrentHint: Max concurrent inferences this runtime can handle in parallel.
